document.title: Keep group source clicks on the current group
document.summary: `openTargetForSource` prefers the current group's lookFor, then any group that lists the source, then document lookFor. Overview lookFor starts open, hops use hash links, and source labels match claim text.
document.why: [The request](source:s1) says a source listed on a group must not jump to Overview when document lookFor also cites it.

sources.label: Cursor session · Sep 13
sources.gist: Clicking a source from a group's Sources list jumped to Overview when document lookFor also cited that source.

sources.label: PR #81
sources.title: Keep group source clicks on the current group
sources.gist: The pull request names the stay-on-group ranking, then a polish pass for lookFor and source hops.

lookFor: [The request](source:s1) also wants a document-only cite to open Overview. That path is the last lookFor step, after group claims and named membership.

groups.title: Prefer the current group
groups.why: [The request](source:s1) needs the open target to keep the reader on the group they are already reading.
groups.summary: `openTargetForSource` ranks pin, current group lookFor, `groupSourceIds` membership, any group lookFor, named sources, then document lookFor. `App` passes the current group id.
lookFor: [The request](source:s1) says opening this source from the group's Sources list stays on the group and focuses this claim.

groups.title: Look for chevrons and hash links
groups.why: The same review asked for Overview lookFor to start open, with chevrons and link-like hops, so the ranking is usable.
groups.summary: `HashLink` writes the selection hash. Overview lookFor starts expanded with a disclosure chevron. Sidebar, lookFor rows, and sources use those links. Source labels match lookFor claim text.
lookFor: On Overview, the document lookFor details start open and show a chevron that rotates when the section closes.
Look for group rows, source labels, and sidebar titles are underlined on the text node so a flex hop still reads as a link.

commits.subject: Paint hop underlines on the text node
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Flex HashLinks never showed hover:underline on their children. Underline the label text instead so Look for rows, sources, and sidebar titles read as links.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Open Overview lookFor and style review hops as links
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Overview lookFor starts expanded with a disclosure chevron. Sidebar,
lookFor rows, and sources use hash links with hover underline. Source
labels match lookFor claim size and weight.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Prefer the current group when opening a shared source
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Document lookFor claims come first in the list, so a citation that also
belongs to a group jumped to Overview. Prefer the current group's claim,
then any group lookFor, then named membership.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>
